newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Fernandez rules out debt buyback.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Fernandez rules out debt buyback.

text.p: Argentine Economy Minister Roque Fernandez denied market-moving rumours that Argentina would buyback debt to alleviate interest payments next year, the daily Clarin reported on Sunday.

"There is no intention of engaging in a foreign debt buyback scheme. And we are certainly not thinking of a program such as the one carried out in Mexico," Fernandez told Clarin in Washington, where he is meeting International Monetary Fund officials.
Argentine debt buyback rumours had buyoed markets last week.
